lines.speaker: Lena Ortiz
lines.text: Okay, okay, before we start, quick names. I'm Lena, this is my place.

lines.speaker: Jonah Pierce
lines.text: I'm Jonah, I work with Lena at the library, and this is my brother

lines.speaker: Eli Pierce
lines.text: Eli. I can say my own name, Jonah.

lines.speaker: Tessa Quinn
lines.text: Hi, I'm Tessa, Lena's roommate. I teach third grade.

lines.speaker: Kofi Mensah
lines.text: And I'm Kofi. Kofi Mensah. I'm the one who keeps winning.

lines.speaker: Kofi Mensah
lines.text: I won twice! Jonah and I go way back, we met at band camp in 2014.

lines.speaker: Kofi Mensah
lines.text: No, it was 2014, I had braces.

lines.speaker: Tessa Quinn
lines.text: Okay, so Eli, what do you do?

lines.speaker: Eli Pierce
lines.text: I'm a line cook at a diner downtown. Night shifts, mostly.

lines.speaker: Lena Ortiz
lines.text: Who wants to shuffle? Kofi, you shuffle.

lines.speaker: Jonah Pierce
lines.text: So Tessa, how long have you and Lena lived together?

lines.speaker: Tessa Quinn
lines.text: Three years. We met in college at Ohio State, in 2018. We were in the same dorm.

lines.speaker: Lena Ortiz
lines.text: She stole my parking spot the first week.

lines.speaker: Kofi Mensah
lines.text: Okay, the four of us, me, Jonah, Lena, and Nate Ross, we do trivia every Thursday at the pub on Elm Street. We are the Thursday Quizzards.

lines.speaker: Lena Ortiz
lines.text: We won the spring league in 2023, thank you very much.

lines.speaker: Eli Pierce
lines.text: Wait, Nate Ross, or Nate Kim?

lines.speaker: Jonah Pierce
lines.text: Nate Ross. Nate Kim is Kofi's boss, at the bike shop.

lines.speaker: Tessa Quinn
lines.text: Okay, I play the red seven.

lines.speaker: Eli Pierce
lines.text: Hey Kofi, are you still with Nora?

lines.speaker: Kofi Mensah
lines.text: Yeah, Nora and I got engaged in August, on the camping trip at Crater Lake.

lines.speaker: Jonah Pierce
lines.text: I was there. He dropped the ring in the tent.

lines.speaker: Jonah Pierce
lines.text: Gwen and I dated for two years in college. We broke up in 2019, but we are still close friends.

lines.speaker: Tessa Quinn
lines.text: Is she the one who runs the bakery?

lines.speaker: Eli Pierce
lines.text: And our cousin Walt works for her now.

lines.speaker: Lena Ortiz
lines.text: Okay, Tessa and I are hosting a Friendsgiving next week, on the twenty second. Everyone is invited.

lines.speaker: Jonah Pierce
lines.text: Wait, Lena, should I bring anything? I make a decent pie.

lines.speaker: Lena Ortiz
lines.text: Pie, yes. Eli, can you bring the stuffing from the diner?

lines.speaker: Tessa Quinn
lines.text: Kofi, bring Nora. I want to see the ring.

lines.speaker: Kofi Mensah
lines.text: She'll love that. She has been showing it to everyone at work.
